_comment: C0-13 flux bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（midjourney/stability-ai），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [veo]，related 键按正文链接行对齐）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: Model family with an iteration line disclosed on the official blog: FLUX 3 (2026-07-23 "Real World Models" multimodal flow-model entry), FLUX 3 Video Part 1 (2026-08-04), FLUX Video Upscale 2K/4K (2026-08-20), FLUX 3 Action (2026-09-23), FLUX 3 Image Klein (2026-10-15, 5.6B open-weights entry) — verified by direct fetch of bfl.ai/blog on 2026-10-21; some weights are open and self-hostable.
axes.runtime: Hosted line: official API and playground, generation in the cloud; open line: weights downloadable for self-hosting, plus an official on-device entry (FLUX.2 Klein into ASUS ProArt laptops, 2026-06-04).
axes.local_files: API/playground can upload images as input; on the self-hosted line, when the model runs locally the data never leaves your machine.
axes.background: The API is request-output based: tasks run in the cloud, clients can disconnect and poll to retrieve results; no official statement of a "keep-running-after-shutdown" form — the model interface itself carries no cross-session tasks.
axes.tools: The main form is a model interface (API/playground) integrated by third-party apps and platforms (e.g. Runway, various image workflows); the official side does not build an end-user creation suite.
axes.context: The model interface is stateless: each request is independent, with no cross-request memory; context continuity is organized by the caller's application layer (multi-reference-image input is an in-request capability, not session memory).
axes.permissions: Official ToS: inputs and outputs may by default be used to improve the model, opting out requires an email request to legal@blackforestlabs.ai; the terms explicitly restrict "training other models on Outputs" (1.3(n)).
axes.fit: People/teams that want the official FLUX API, or want to self-host open FLUX weights. Hosted and self-hosted licensing paths differ — confirm which one you are on before commercial use; anyone doing model training should note the 1.3(n) output-training ban.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. Image generation does not fit the coding test protocol; capability claims follow the official blog and model cards.
unknowns:
- The full current model lineup and tier routing of the hosted API (disclosed entry by entry on the blog; this site has not verified each tier)
- The concrete commercial boundaries of each open-weight license (per-model licenses not verified one by one by this site)
related: Contrast route: closed-source community form, outputs public by default and remixable
Contrast route: platform + open weights, both lines
